summary.intent: Fix a data race in the review package that caused test:ci failures under -race, then push the fix to the open PR for local test reliability improvements.
summary.outcome: Added an early cancelled-context return in multipicker.go to prevent Bubble Tea/huh from constructing a terminal reader when the context is already done, eliminating the race. Committed and pushed as a follow-up on PR #1154.

repo: The review package multipicker.go (PickAgents) constructs a real Bubble Tea/huh form even when the context is already cancelled, which causes a data race under -race between the form's shutdown close of the cancelreader and the ultraviolet input goroutine's concurrent read.
test:ci runs go test -tags=integration -race ./..., so races in non-integration packages surface there.
e2e canary failures in this sandbox were write-permission artifacts (~/.vogon/sessions not writable), not product failures — historical CI green confirmed the canary itself was fine.
When one test in a package has a race, Go's -race detector marks all subsequently run tests in that package as failed, inflating the apparent failure count.

code.finding: PickAgents called huh Form.RunWithContext without first checking ctx.Err(); added early return before form construction to avoid the cancelreader race under -race.

TestPickAgents_CancelledContextReturnsPickerCancelled passes a pre-cancelled context to PickAgents; this exposed the race because Bubble Tea still started its input goroutine before honoring cancellation.

workflow: Scoping a race fix to a single package with go test -race ./cmd/entire/cli/review -count=1 is fast enough to iterate on before running the full test:ci suite.
The PR was created without a Linear card in the title by user request — skip Linear key when user says 'we don't need a linear card for this one'.
Unrelated changed files (.opencode/package-lock.json, docs/file-edit-tool-hooks.md) were intentionally excluded from the commit.

friction: Sandbox write-permission errors for ~/.vogon/sessions caused spurious e2e canary failures, requiring a re-run outside the sandbox to confirm green.
test:ci output was sparse during the race-enabled go test phase because the task still uses raw Go output rather than gotestsum.
The race only manifests under -race with specific goroutine scheduling, making it non-deterministic and historically not caught in CI green runs.
open_items: The upstream race in muesli/cancelreader + charmbracelet/ultraviolet is a third-party issue; the local fix is a workaround, not a root-cause fix in those libraries.
test:ci task still uses raw go test output for the race phase — could be switched to gotestsum like the other tasks for better visibility.
Untracked docs/file-edit-tool-hooks.md was left out of this PR and may need its own commit/PR.
